caption: The drawing features two views of a wooden chest of drawers, rendered in light brown tones on a beige background. The left side depicts a frontal view, showing a tall chest with multiple drawers arranged in two main sections: the upper section has five smaller drawers, including a central drawer decorated with a carved floral motif, and the lower section has three wider drawers. Below these, there are four additional drawers: two small, one medium, and one large central drawer, flanked by four turned legs and a shaped lower apron. The right side presents a side view of the same piece of furniture, illustrating its depth, straight back, and the proportional relationship between the upper and lower sections, also supported by four straight legs. Both views are centered on the page, with ample blank space surrounding them. The illustration is detailed with fine lines indicating wood grain and hardware on the drawers.
title: Highboy-front and Side Views
